pages.title: A Soft Landing
pages.text: Feathers support the journey, while the rewarded Shaggy Pelt continues the textile route

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Shearing a living Snowdo produces feathers, which regrow through its native mechanic. Holding the bird slows a real fall. A short descent is enough to try it
